name: What is the typical cost for site preparation and utility hookups for a tiny home?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for site preparation and utility hookups for a tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for site preparation and utility hookups can vary widely based on the existing conditions of your lot and local service provider fees. It may include grading, excavation, foundation work, trenching for utility lines, and connection fees. A general estimate for these services often ranges from several thousand dollars to tens of thousands, depending on the complexity and distance to existing connections. Zen Tiny Homes can provide a more detailed estimate after a site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Site prep and utility hookup costs vary greatly, typically from thousands to tens of thousands of dollars, depending on lot conditions and connection complexity.
